Inspection of the vehicle confirms damage consistent with a sideswipe to the right
rear quarter panel while changing lanes. The rear bumper cover is scuffed and cracked
at the right corner, the quarter panel shows a long shallow dent with paint transfer,
and the right tail lamp housing is displaced. The damage pattern lines up with the
impact as described. Nothing in the file or on the vehicle suggests earlier damage to
these areas. The shop's labor hours for panel repair, refinishing, and lamp
replacement are reasonable for this scope. Invoices submitted show no repeated charges
for the same work. Recommended plan: replace the bumper cover, repair and refinish the
quarter panel, and install a new tail lamp assembly.
